title: OnCallResponderStructuredOutput
description: Vendor-neutral structured output schema for headless AI incident responders (Codex / Claude Code).

alert_name.description: Name of the firing Prometheus alert

summary.description: Concise summary of the root cause identified from bounded evidence.

failing_component.description: Specific microservice, package, handler, or endpoint that failed.

suspected_commit.description: Git commit SHA suspected of introducing the regression.

confidence.description: Model confidence level in the diagnosis.

proposed_action.description: Action proposed by the model to restore system health.

command.description: Exact concrete shell or operational command proposed.

reproduction_test.description: Automated regression test command or code reproducing the failure before remediation.

reversible.description: Whether the proposed action can be safely reverted without state loss.

blast_radius.description: Scope of impact (e.g., single service, container restart, full cluster).

required_autonomy_level.description: Autonomy tier required to execute this action under autonomy-policy.yaml.
